coppa-check 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Introduces a free COPPA compliance check skill with automated scoring via the CQDev cloud compliance engine (compliancehub.cn).
- Covers 12 essential COPPA Rule items, including parental consent, data security, third-party disclosure, age screening, and more.
- Allows an offline preview mode (no scoring, no API Key required) and a scored cloud mode (free API Key required, 100 calls included).
- Guides users through obtaining and storing their API Key securely.
- Ensures all data transmissions are limited to the official compliancehub.cn endpoint with strict network and security practices.
- Includes clear legal disclaimers and open MIT licensing.
